metric_definitions.cost_savings_eur: Baseline annual cost less scenario annual cost.

blocks.body:
## Decision view

Compare transparent operating strategies for a fictional manufacturing network. All inputs are deterministic and synthetic; no company or team-project data are used.

## Method and guardrails

Flexible load moves only within the same plant-day. Daily energy is conserved, the non-flexible portion never moves, and each interval has explicit lower and upper bounds. The scenarios are decision-support examples—not production schedules or forecasts.
